display.purpose: Use only for the saved starting-point statement.

headline.purpose: Use for the current form task or route-level heading.

body.purpose: Use for explanatory copy and form values.

label.purpose: Use for field labels, checkpoints, and navigation.

components.name: Setup Primary Action
components.description: The single advancing action in each Setup checkpoint.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; width: 100%; cursor: pointer; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #c2410c; color: #ffffff; padding: 0 20px; font: 600 16px/24px system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(194,65,12,0.24); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9a3412; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f97316; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #9a3412; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Setup Field
components.description: The labeled input or select for a deliberate user-entered value.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-balance">Current balance</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-balance" placeholder="0.00" inputmode="decimal">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; color: #292524; font: 500 14px/20px system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-field { box-sizing: border-box; display: block; min-height: 48px; width: 100%; margin-top: 8px; border: 1px solid #d6d3d1; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; color: #1c1917; padding: 0 12px; font: 400 16px/24px system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #a8a29e; } .ds-field:focus { border-color: #f97316; outline: 2px solid #fed7aa; outline-offset: 0; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f97316; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; background: #f5f5f4; color: #78716c; }

components.name: Account Choice Card
components.description: A visible-radio choice between attaching an existing account and creating one.
components.css: .ds-choice-card { display: flex; min-height: 56px; cursor: pointer; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 1px solid #d6d3d1; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; color: #292524; padding: 0 16px; font: 500 14px/20px system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-choice-card:has(.ds-choice-radio:checked) { border-color: #f97316; background: #ffedd5; } .ds-choice-radio { width: 16px; height: 16px; accent-color: #ea580c; } .ds-choice-radio:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f97316; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Rail Item
components.description: A compact route item for the desktop rail and mobile more-menu.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #4b5563; padding: 8px 12px; font: 500 14px/20px system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #fff7ed; color: #1c1917; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #ffedd5; color: #c2410c; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f97316; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Progress Ring
components.description: A compact milestone indicator that pairs percentage with completion count.
components.html: 64%7/11
components.css: .ds-progress { position: relative; display: inline-flex; width: 100px; height: 100px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-progress svg { width: 100px; height: 100px; transform: rotate(-90deg); } .ds-progress circle { fill: none; stroke-width: 8; } .ds-progress-track { stroke: #f3f4f6; } .ds-progress-value { stroke: url(#ds-progress-gradient); stroke-linecap: round; stroke-dasharray: 263.9; stroke-dashoffset: 95; transition: stroke-dashoffset 700ms cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-progress span { position: absolute; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; } .ds-progress strong { color: #111827; font: 700 20px/28px system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-progress small { color: #6b7280; font: 400 12px/16px system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Savings Coach treats financial input as a deliberate record, not a performance dashboard. Warm paper surfaces make manual entry approachable. Dark anchoring areas mark orientation and completion. Orange identifies the next action, not generic decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet warm neutrals keep planning and balance entry readable for extended use.
Orange has a single job: mark an action, current route, current checkpoint, or measured progress.
Rounded controls soften data entry, while dark panels create a stable visual anchor.
Numbers use tabular figures when the value needs comparison or confirmation.

rules.name: The Manual-First Rule
rules.body: The interface must make a user-entered amount feel explicit and recoverable. It must not imply a bank connection, transaction confirmation, or automatic money movement.

rules.name: The Orange Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Orange must communicate the current or next meaningful state. Do not use it as a second neutral, a decorative page wash, or a substitute for hierarchy.

rules.name: The Dark Anchor Rule
rules.body: The dark panel is reserved for navigation, orientation, and success confirmation. Keep its supporting copy subdued so the current checkpoint or confirmed value remains dominant.

rules.name: The Value First Rule
rules.body: When an amount is the action's subject, give the amount a larger numeric treatment than its supporting label.

rules.name: The One Task Rule
rules.body: A form surface presents one current user decision. Keep secondary detail in helper copy, the progress rail, or a following step.

rules.name: The Resting Surface Rule
rules.body: Do not add a shadow to every card. Elevation must indicate an interactive response or the next action.

dos: Do use a warm canvas, white fields, and dark text for routine data entry.
Do reserve orange for the current step, the primary action, selected navigation, and progress.
Do use tabular numerals for financial values and comparison counts.
Do maintain 48px minimum targets and visible keyboard focus.
Do state manual-entry limits plainly when a balance or completion could be mistaken for a bank-confirmed event.
donts: Don't imply that Savings Coach connects to a bank, transfers money, or confirms a bank transaction.
Don't turn every card into a raised container or add shadows without a state purpose.
Don't use orange as ordinary body text or a general background color.
Don't hide validation in placeholders or color alone; keep labels, error text, and focus visible.
Don't introduce a display font, uppercase dashboard labels, or non-tabular financial figures.
